backend/main.mo: Defines authorization-backed user profiles and a full bookkeeping data model with inventory, customers, income, expenses, sales, workers, and attendance records.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence entries linking feature requirements to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of all main frontend source files and their purposes.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind-based OKLCH color variables and theme styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component managing authentication, profile setup flow, and rendering the dashboard or login prompt.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the application footer with branding and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays app branding, user info, and login/logout controls using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/LoginPrompt.tsx: Public landing screen describing app features and prompting the user to log in.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal for first‑time users to submit and save their display name profile.
frontend/src/components/tabs/AttendanceT: Displays worker attendance with search and filtering, and provides dialogs to add workers and mark attendance using query hooks.
frontend/src/components/tabs/CustomersTa: Manages customers with search, add-customer dialog, and viewing purchase history for a selected customer.
Shows expense records with search and category filtering, and includes a dialog to add new expense entries.
frontend/src/components/tabs/IncomeTab.t: Lists income records with search and source filtering, and provides a form dialog for adding new income entries.
frontend/src/components/tabs/InventoryTa: Manages inventory items with search and type filtering, plus dialogs for adding and editing items using backend mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/tabs/SalesTab.ts: Displays sales records with search, computed details, and a dialog to add new sales using inventory and customer data.
Computes and shows financial and inventory summaries, low‑stock alerts, and recent transactions with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and status handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for CRUD operations on profiles, inventory, customers, sales, income, expenses, and other backend entities.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and defines CSS variables for light and dark themes across the UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard with tabbed navigation for summary, income, expenses, inventory, customers, sales, and attendance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL and hash parameters plus store, retrieve, and clear values in sessionStorage, including a combined URL-or-session lookup.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: TailwindCSS configuration defining theme extensions, color tokens, keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing requirements, known issues, existing features, and pending authorization-related fixes.
